name: Synthetic AI service reliability scenario
default_run: The default run plays once and holds recovery. Use --loop only for repeating local demos.

phase_metrics.name: Normal
phase_metrics.summary: Traffic, latency, errors, saturation, dependencies, and behavior are normal.
phase_metrics.expected: Current state is Normal, burn is sustainable, behavior is low, and no default alerts fire.

phase_metrics.name: Infrastructure / capacity issue
phase_metrics.summary: Latency and saturation rise, and behavior-change stays secondary.
phase_metrics.expected: Golden signals and burn show user impact; behavior panels do not claim AI behavior as primary cause.

phase_metrics.name: Dependency/provider issue
phase_metrics.summary: Provider latency, provider errors, and rate limits rise before or alongside service impact.
phase_metrics.expected: Dependency panels route investigation to the provider/dependency runbook.

phase_metrics.name: Silent AI-behavior change
phase_metrics.summary: Request rate, latency, and errors stay normal while behavior-change rises.
phase_metrics.expected: Behavior alert is Watch, not Page, and next action routes to AI/model investigation.

phase_metrics.name: Deploy-correlated behavior change
phase_metrics.summary: A model, prompt, index, config, or app version becomes active before behavior changes.
phase_metrics.expected: Release dashboard shows canary/stable difference and rollback evidence without paging solely on behavior.

phase_metrics.name: Behavior + quality drop
phase_metrics.summary: Behavior-change rises and the delayed quality or business proxy degrades.
phase_metrics.expected: Behavior plus quality evidence can become incident-level under configured policy.

phase_metrics.name: Stale baseline
phase_metrics.summary: Behavior movement appears while the baseline is stale.
phase_metrics.expected: Baseline trust warns and behavior alerts are suppressed or downgraded.

phase_metrics.name: Low traffic
phase_metrics.summary: Behavior movement appears with too little traffic to trust the sample.
phase_metrics.expected: Low-volume state appears and behavior alerts are suppressed or downgraded.

phase_metrics.name: Recovery
phase_metrics.summary: Mitigation occurs and SLO burn, dependency health, and behavior evidence return toward normal.
phase_metrics.expected: Recovery panel confirms sustained service-health and behavior stabilization before closure.
